name: Minimal SDXL text-to-image

base_image.digest: sha256:<the image digest; from `docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'` or the pod's detail page>

code_deps.name: ComfyUI
code_deps._exclude_note: Recipes, not outputs: output directories are not packed. Models travel as separately content-addressed `files[]` entries and must never be mixed into the source archive, or the same bytes are stored twice.

python_lock.lockfile_path: <relative path to the uv lockfile. Generate it first: `cd /workspace && uv pip freeze > requirements.lock`, then put `requirements.lock` here>

license.note: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M: re-hosting counts as distribution, so a copy serves only its owner's rebuild and bytes are never served across users.

comfyui.workflow_path: <relative path to the workflow JSON from the run that worked, e.g. ComfyUI/user/default/workflows/sdxl.json>

verified_run.queue_completed_at: <optional, ISO 8601 timestamp of the successful run>

_note: Packing template for the minimal SDXL text-to-image case. Fill in the `<placeholders>` on a pod where the setup already works, then feed it to `renest pack`. All paths are relative to `--dir` (the environment root, usually `/workspace`). Hashes, sizes, archives and the environment fingerprint are computed by `renest pack`; do not fill them in by hand.
_files_note: Pick one `serving_scope` (if unsure, leave it out -- `renest pack` falls back to `gated`): `private` = your own material (self-trained weights, your own assets); `open` = the licence itself permits redistribution (Apache-2.0, MIT); `gated` = restricted (assets that forbid re-hosting, models that require a login to download), which **must** carry `origin_url`, because downstream has to fetch it from the source with their own credentials.
